name: Terra/UST/LUNA Death Spiral (May 2022)
speed: UST: $1.00 -> $0.0997 in ~6 days (May 7-13), with the terminal leg $0.93 -> $0.10 in ~72h; LUNA: -99.99%+ in ~4 days (May 9-13); ~$50B of LUNA+UST valuation destroyed in under a week (NBER: 'collapsed in three days'); BTC -36% May 5 -> May 12; Terra TVL -90%+ in 5 days.
summary: 7-13 мая 2022: смертельная спираль UST/LUNA — UST $1→$0.10, LUNA −99.99%, $50B уничтожено за считанные дни (NBER: bank run, а не единый атакующий), LFG продала ~80k BTC резервов, продавив BTC к $25.4k (−36% с 5 мая). USDC держал пег С ПРЕМИЕЙ; USDT — $0.945 intraday (venue-wick). Книга SPA не касалась UST по вайтлисту — и это главный защитный механизм здесь: refusal-first, а не пороги (Anchor 19.5% прошёл бы APY-гейт <30%). Книга SPA на 2026-08: aave_v3 40% / pendle (PT_USDC) 20% / maple 15% / morpho_steakhouse 15% / кэш USDC 10%.

timeline.event: Pre-event state: Anchor holds ~$14B UST deposits (~75% of UST supply) at 19.5% subsidized yield; Terra chain TVL ~$21.7B (2nd after Ethereum; April peak ~$29-30B); LFG reserve as of May 7: 80,394 BTC (~$3.5B) + other assets; BTC already sliding post-FOMC from May 5 high ~$39,789.

Trigger (time approx from Chainalysis/litigation reporting): Terraform Labs withdraws 150M UST from Curve UST/3CRV pool ahead of planned 4pool migration, thinning liquidity; minutes later a single 85M UST->USDC swap (largest ever in the pool) pushes UST's pool share from ~33% to ~66%; UST slips to ~$0.985.

Anchor run begins (single-sourced timestamp): large withdrawals start ~21:47 UTC; two large addresses pull ~375M UST; ~280M UST leaves Anchor within 24h. NBER identifies May 7 position adjustments by a few large UST holders as the start of the run.

UST trades $0.985-$0.995; Anchor loses ~20% of deposits over May 7-8; LUNA -17%. LFG begins converting BTC reserve: transfers 52,189 BTC to trade with a counterparty for ~1,515,689,462 UST (per LFG's May 16 disclosure).

First deep depeg: UST falls to ~$0.60-0.65 intraday (venue-dependent), partially recovers toward ~$0.90; ~5B UST (35% of the 14B) withdrawn from Anchor on May 9 alone, deposits $14B (Fri) -> $8.7B (Mon); LUNA -~48-50% on the day (~$62 -> ~$30). Do Kwon tweets 'Deploying more capital - steady lads'; LFG council votes to deploy $1.5B ($750M BTC to OTC firms + 750M UST).

LFG executes on-chain swaps of its final 33,206 BTC for ~1,164,018,521 UST in last-ditch peg defense. UST recovers to ~$0.93 (its final peak) then fades; LFG reported seeking >$1B outside capital; BTC dips below $31k as market fears LFG reserve dumping.

Peg defense fails: UST slides to ~$0.26-0.30; LUNA drops below $8 (>90% off weekly); cumulative Anchor withdrawals exceed 11B UST; Celsius withdraws its remaining ~225,000 ETH (~$463M bETH collateral) from Anchor early May 11, exiting fully before the bottom; governance moves to raise base pool / speed UST burning.
Death-spiral peak: peg-arb redemptions hyperinflate LUNA supply; LUNA -96% on the day to <$0.10, then <$0.01; UST hits ~$0.22-0.23 on Binance; several exchanges suspend LUNA trading.

Contagion to majors and stablecoins: BTC prints $25,401.29 (lowest since Dec 26, 2020); ETH low ~$1,701 (both ~-30% over 7 days); USDT breaks peg intraday to ~$0.945-0.9485 (FTX/Kraken; ~$0.9455 composite), Tether keeps redeeming ($10B+ over the following two weeks) and recovers within days; USDC/DAI trade at a premium (flight to quality).

Terra chain HALT #1 at block height 7,603,700 (time approx): validators stop the chain because hyperinflated LUNA supply collapsed the cost of a governance attack; chain restarts after an emergency patch disabling new delegations.

Terra chain HALT #2 at block height 7,607,789, less than 24h after the first (time approx, early hours UTC); block production resumes ~13:30 UTC May 13 with on-chain swaps and IBC disabled — chain-wide de facto withdrawal freeze while halted.

Terminal prints: LUNA supply reaches ~6.5T tokens (from ~343-380M on May 9-10, ~+1,900,000%); LUNA trades ~$0.0003 -> below $0.0001 (effectively zero); UST hits then-all-time low $0.0997; Binance halts/removes LUNA and UST spot+margin pairs (00:40 GMT settlement), OKX and others delist.

Oracle failure spillover (May 12-13): Chainlink pauses its LUNA feed at $0.107 while market price is ~$0.01; attackers deposit near-worthless LUNA as collateral: Venus Protocol (BNB Chain) drained of ~$13.5M borrowed (~$11.2M net loss), Blizz Finance (Avalanche) drained ~$8.3M (protocol killed) — ~$21.8M combined.

LFG discloses reserve accounting: 313 BTC remain of 80,394 (net ~80,081 BTC deployed, ~$2.7-3B at execution prices); UST trades below $0.20; Terra ecosystem TVL down from ~$21.7-30B to <$3B; NBER later estimates ~$50B of LUNA+UST valuation wiped out in days.
Aftermath: Terra 2.0 (Phoenix-1) launches without a stablecoin; original chain renamed Terra Classic (LUNC/USTC); UST never repegs (USTC settles at cents).
Contagion seed 1 matures: Celsius — weakened by the post-Terra environment and stETH discount despite having exited Anchor — freezes all withdrawals; files Chapter 11 July 13.

Contagion seed 2 matures: Three Arrows Capital confirms heavy LUNA losses (~$200M invested in LFG's Feb 2022 round; reported ~$560-600M position value locked/wiped); fails margin calls mid-June, ordered liquidated in BVI June 27, files Chapter 15 July 1 — cascading into Voyager, BlockFi, Genesis.

btc.window: May 5 local high ($39,789, StatMuse) -> May 12 low ($25,401.29, CNBC). Within the strict Terra window (May 7 ~$34,500-35,500 -> May 12) the move is ~-26 to -29%. LFG's ~80k BTC liquidation (May 8-10) plus macro risk-off drove it.

eth.window: 7 days into May 12: contemporaneous reporting has ETH 'down about 30% in the past seven days' to a ~$1,701 low on May 12; exact pre-event reference price not pinned from a primary source here (was ~$2,700-2,940 early May depending on day).

luna.window: ~May 5 ($82.55 per Newsweek; ATH $116-119 April 5-6) -> May 13 (~$0.0003 then <$0.0001; ~$0.000001 prints cited). Supply hyperinflated ~343-380M -> ~6.5T tokens May 9-13.

ust.window: May 7 ($0.985 first crack) -> May 13 ($0.0997 then-ATL); never repegged — kept sliding to cents (USTC).

broader_crypto.note: Estimates of broader crypto market losses in the surrounding weeks range ~$200-400B+ (Forbes framed the wider April-May slide as a '$1 trillion meltdown' from the April peak); the ~$50B figure is specifically LUNA+UST valuation per NBER.

defi_impact.liquidations_usd: Crypto-wide derivatives liquidations exceeded ~$1B/day on the worst days (May 9-12) per contemporaneous aggregator reports — approximate, not precisely sourced here (Coinglass history paywalled)
defi_impact.gas: No documented sustained extreme Ethereum gas crisis (unlike Mar 2020); elevated activity around Curve pool exits and the May 12 USDT wobble
defi_impact.oracle_behavior: Critical failure mode: Chainlink PAUSED the LUNA feed at $0.107 during freefall (market ~$0.01); protocols that kept accepting LUNA collateral at the stale price were drained (Venus $13.5M borrowed/$11.2M loss; Blizz $8.3M, protocol killed by its own timelock preventing a fast pause). Terra's native oracle spreads blew out during hyperinflation
defi_impact.withdrawal_freezes: Terra chain halted twice (blocks 7,603,700 May 12 and 7,607,789 May 13; restarted with delegations, then swaps/IBC disabled) = chain-wide freeze of ALL assets; exchanges suspended Terra deposits/withdrawals and delisted LUNA/UST (Binance settlement 00:40 GMT May 13); notably Anchor itself never froze — the run cleared BECAUSE withdrawals stayed open
defi_impact.dex_liquidity: Curve UST/3CRV went from balanced to ~66% then ~95% UST (exit-only, deep discount); the planned 4pool was stillborn; Terra DEXes (Astroport/Terraswap) liquidity evaporated; wormhole-wrapped UST stranded on Ethereum/Solana/Avalanche
protocols_paused_or_insolvent: entire Terra dApp ecosystem (Mirror, Astroport, Mars, etc.)
defi_impact.bridge_chain_availability: Terra IBC channels closed during/after halts; bridged UST unredeemable at par anywhere

causes.primary: Structurally fragile algorithmic stablecoin: UST was backed only by endogenous collateral (LUNA seigniorage), while ~75% of UST supply sat in Anchor earning a subsidized, unsustainable 19.5% yield — a classic run-prone deposit base with a redemption mechanism that guarantees hyperinflation under stress (death spiral).
secondary: Curve 4pool migration removed 150M UST of pool liquidity at the exact moment large UST->USDC sells hit (May 7), making the initial depeg cheap to cause and easy to see
Macro risk-off backdrop (Fed +50bp May 4; BTC already -10%+ into May 7) pre-weakened bid for all crypto collateral
LFG's BTC reserve (~$3.5B) was far too small versus ~$18B+ UST supply, and its forced deployment transmitted the run into BTC itself, deepening system-wide fear
On-chain transparency accelerated the run: investors could watch Anchor/Curve outflows in real time (NBER: sophisticated/wealthy investors ran first and lost least; retail ran late and lost most)
Mint/redemption base-pool capacity limits caused redemption spreads to blow out, breaking the arb that was supposed to restore the peg
causes.mechanism: Curve UST/3CRV liquidity withdrawn (150M UST) -> 85M UST dump imbalances pool -> UST ~$0.985 -> Anchor run begins (May 7) -> withdrawals snowball ($14B -> $8.7B by May 9; >11B out by May 11) -> UST breaks to $0.60s -> peg-arb burns UST / mints LUNA -> LUNA supply explodes 343M -> 6.5T, price -99.99% -> seigniorage backing evaporates faster than redemptions clear -> LFG sells 80k BTC into the market, BTC -> $25.4k, panic broadens, USDT wobbles to ~$0.95 -> LUNA hyperinflation collapses cost of governance attack -> validators halt chain twice (blocks 7,603,700 and 7,607,789) -> exchanges delist, oracle feeds pause (Venus/Blizz drained) -> ecosystem TVL -> ~0; credit contagion (3AC, Celsius et al.) detonates over the following 6 weeks.

contagion: Curve UST/3CRV: 150M UST liquidity withdrawal + 85M UST->USDC dump (May 7 ~21:44 UTC) -> UST $0.985
Anchor bank run: $14B deposits -> $8.7B by May 9, >11B UST withdrawn by May 11
Peg-arb mint spiral: LUNA supply ~343-380M -> ~6.5T (May 9-13), LUNA $62 -> <$0.0001
LFG sells BTC reserves: 52,189 BTC (May 8) + 33,206 BTC (May 10), 80,394 -> 313 BTC -> BTC sell pressure, $25,401 low May 12
Stablecoin flight: USDT to ~$0.945-0.95 intraday May 12, $10B+ redemptions in 2 weeks; USDC/DAI at premium
Oracle failure spillover: Chainlink LUNA feed paused at $0.107 vs ~$0.01 market -> Venus (~$11.2M loss) and Blizz (~$8.3M, fatal) drained
Infrastructure freeze: Terra chain halted twice (blocks 7,603,700 / 7,607,789), IBC/swaps disabled, exchanges delist LUNA/UST, wormhole-wrapped UST stranded
Fund/lender losses: 3AC ~$200M LFG round (~$560-600M reported position) wiped -> margin calls June -> BVI liquidation June 27 / Chapter 15 July 1
Lender runs: Celsius freezes withdrawals June 12 (Ch.11 July 13) despite exiting Anchor in time; Voyager, BlockFi hit via 3AC loans; Genesis weakened
Sets the stage for the full 2022 credit cascade culminating in FTX (Nov 2022)

recovery.time_to_recover: UST/LUNA: never — Terra 2.0 launched May 28, 2022 without a stablecoin; USTC/LUNC settled at fractions of a cent. USDT: repegged within days. BTC/ETH: bounced to ~$30k/$2.1k within a week but made new lows in June 2022 (BTC ~$17.6k) as Terra-seeded credit contagion (Celsius June 12, 3AC late June, Voyager/BlockFi) detonated; pre-Terra price levels not durably reclaimed until 2023-24.
recovery.notes: This event is the canonical proof that an 'unbreakable' $18B stablecoin can go to ~zero in 6 days, that reserve defense can transmit stress to the reserve asset (BTC), and that the second-order credit damage arrives on a 4-8 WEEK lag, not during the acute window.

confidence_notes: Observed, multi-sourced facts: LFG reserve accounting (80,394 -> 313 BTC; 52,189 BTC May 8 + 33,206 BTC May 10, per LFG's own May 16 disclosure via CoinDesk/CryptoBriefing); BTC low $25,401.29 May 12 (CNBC); Anchor $14B -> $8.7B by May 9 (CoinDesk); halt block heights 7,603,700 / 7,607,789; Venus $11.2M / Blizz $8.3M oracle-pause losses (rekt.news + The Record); UST then-ATL $0.0997 May 13 (CNBC/FXEmpire); LUNA supply to ~6.5T; USDT ~$0.945-0.9485 May 12; NBER $50B estimate. Contested/approximate: (1) Terra TVL on the eve — $21.7B (DeFiLlama May) vs $29-30B (late-April peak) vs one $35B claim; I treat $21.7B as event-eve and $29-30B as April peak. (2) UST intraday lows May 9-12 are venue-dependent: May 9 low reported $0.60-0.65, May 11 $0.26-0.30, May 12 $0.22-0.23 (Binance) — treat as ranges. (3) Minute-level timestamps (21:44 UTC Curve trades; 21:47 UTC Anchor outflow start; 280M/375M UST first withdrawals) come from Chainalysis/NBER/litigation as relayed by search indexes and secondary reporting — the primary PDFs (nber.org, chainalysis.com, jumpcrypto.com, federalreserve.gov) were egress-blocked in this environment, so minute precision is stated but not independently re-verified; dates are solid. (4) Exact UTC clock times of the two chain halts are approximate (block heights are the hard facts; halt #2 restart ~13:30 UTC May 13 per Yahoo/Binance-era reporting). (5) ETH pre-event reference price not pinned ($1,701 May 12 low and '-30% in 7 days' are sourced; from_usd left null). (6) Headline destruction figures vary by scope: ~$50B = LUNA+UST valuation (NBER); $40-45B 'ecosystem' figures and ~$60B claims circulate; broader-market loss estimates ($200-400B week, '$1T' from April peak) are wider-window and lower confidence. (7) 3AC exposure: $200M invested in LFG round (well-sourced) vs ~$560-600M position value (reported, medium confidence). (8) LUNA terminal prints below $0.0001 vary by venue ($0.000001 cited); direction not in doubt. (9) Liquidation and gas figures are qualitative — free historical series unavailable. ПРАВКИ АУДИТА: арифметика LFG не сходится — транши 52,189 + 33,206 = 85,395 BTC при резерве 80,394 и «net ~80,081» в раскрытии 16 мая; обе цифры из одного источника, расхождение ~5.3k BTC названо, не сглажено.

spa_relevance.direct_exposure: None of the four SPA venues holds UST — but every channel below hit USDC-based lenders in 2022 and most are reproducible.

per_position_channels.aave_v3_usdc: Channel: liquidity crunch + rate whipsaw, not insolvency. During the run, stablecoin borrow demand spikes (shorting depegging stables, funding exits) — utilization can pin near 100%, making 'withdraw anytime' temporarily false while supply APY spikes then collapses. Aave took no bad debt from Terra, but the Venus/Blizz oracle-pause exploit is the exact failure mode for any Aave-like market listing a collapsing collateral: a PAUSED (stale-high) oracle is worse than a falling one. SPA's fail-CLOSED/live-TVL-only rules map directly.
per_position_channels.pendle_pt_usdc: Channel: underlying-yield-source death + AMM-exit-only liquidity. Anchor was 2022's 'fixed yield' — products wrapping it went to zero with it. A PT is money-good only if the underlying market (and its stable) survives to maturity; mid-crisis the only exit is the AMM at a deep discount (UST pools went 95% one-sided). Stress test: mark PT at crisis AMM depth, not at implied-yield fair value.
per_position_channels.maple_usdc: Channel: slow-burn credit contagion + withdrawal freeze. Terra seeded 3AC/Celsius failures that later produced real Maple events: pool freezes and defaults (Babel mid-2022; Orthogonal ~$36M M11 default Dec 2022; Auros). Undercollateralized lending takes the hit 4-8+ weeks AFTER the trigger, and lockups/queues mean the position is NOT withdrawable exactly when cash is needed. Stress test must model the lag, not just day-of drawdown.
per_position_channels.morpho_steakhouse_usdc: Channel: curated-vault collateral/oracle risk. Vault is money-good only if every collateral market's oracle behaves during freefall; the Chainlink LUNA pause shows the tail: stale feed -> toxic collateral accepted -> bad debt socialized to USDC suppliers. Also same utilization-spike withdrawal friction as Aave.
per_position_channels.cash_10pct: In this event the 10% cash buffer works ONLY if 'cash' is USDC (traded at premium) — a USDT buffer was down ~5% intraday May 12 and only redeemable at par via Tether's own window.

unpriced_if_system_assumes_USDC_eq_1_and: USDT != $1 (May 12: ~$0.945-0.95) — any venue pricing stables at $1 mismarks; a Terra-2022 replay assuming all-stables-at-par misses the whole stablecoin leg

Withdrawability is regime-dependent: utilization pinning (Aave/Morpho), pool lockups (Maple), chain halts (all funds frozen chain-wide twice), and exchange suspensions all break 'always withdrawable' — none is priced by APY
Oracle PAUSE (stale price) risk: distinct from oracle-wrong risk; produced $21.8M of bad debt at Venus/Blizz and is invisible to TVL/APY screens
Credit lag: Maple-style losses arrive weeks after the event window ends — a 7-day stress window scores this crisis as near-zero loss for the SPA book, which is exactly the trap
APY collapse: DeFi-wide TVL -40-50% and the death of the 20%-yield anchor repriced ALL stable yields down for a year — a yield-optimizer's forward-return assumption is the silent casualty
Reflexivity of reserves: LFG selling BTC to defend UST crashed BTC — 'diversified reserves' correlate to 1 in a run; analogous for any protocol whose safety module is its own or a correlated token

assumptions: Книга не держит UST/Anchor (вайтлист) — прямых потерь нет; шоки — вторичные: whipsaw ставок, 3.5%-дисконт receipt-токенов (WARN), ликвидность выхода.
Дефолты Maple (Babel) случились в июне — вне окна, живут в H06/H07.
USDT-депег $0.945 книга НЕ видит: USDT не в списке экспозиций — депег-монитор смотрит только свои символы (честное свойство защиты).
